master.title: Realm kit Blender master

metadata.coordinateSystem: Blender Z-up; standard glTF Y-up export

master.provenance: Original Alibi editable master containing the three composed reference collections.
master.accessibility: Harbour GLB and static thumbnail accompany the editable Blender master.
master.integration: Candidate library only; no runtime import.
master.qa: Master opens with populated scene collections; the companion GLB is structure-checked.
